book.name: Lum
book.title: Ŋwa' wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ kentaashɛ ke Lum

content: Ɛ̀ nu me wvù Baul wvù waa lemme Klistu Jisos. Nyo' to nu ɛ tee me lɛ me enù waa ntum Jisos, gɛɛ lɛ me enfewcì saaka wvù jee wvu wvuwen.
Saaka wvù jee wvun nu wvù Nyo' to kawɛɛ bonyii dvú fele yî bonyii bew bo ntum e, no fí nu ɛ bó ɛ saŋ ɛ̂ Ŋwa' we wvù yuule le.
Wvú nu ɛkumɛ Waa we wvù to joɛ ye wee wvu wum, ɛ bó boo wvú ɛ̂ kfuu di Nfon Dawe le.
Tata wesebeene wvù Jisos Klistu nu ɛ Nyo' to duŋcɛ fele yî Keyoy ke Yuule le lɛ ɛ̀ nu Waa wen wvù kɛŋke mvuŋgay no wvú to bvusɛɛ wvú yî kpwe le.
Ɛ̀ ge Jisos Klistu Nyo' ɛ sɛ buw me lɛ me enù waa we ntum, wvu lɛ me eŋge ɛ́ bonyii bocii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu elese fitele yî ye le, eyuukè ɛ ɛ̀ nu wvú le bensee diee diew.
Ben tɛn nu ŋgoo bonyii bò Nyo' nu ɛ tee wase lɛ bó enù bonyii bo Jisos Klistu le.

Me ɛ no nsaaŋke ŋwa' wvun fô ben e bocii bò nu Lum, bò nu fitele fi Nyo' le, ɛ wvú ɛ tee lɛ bó enù bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bew. Nyo' Icee wesebeene bô Tata Jisos Klistu ebuw ben bô kembonɛn ebvuu enya ben bô mvuntelem mvù lɛɛtene.
Ɛ Baul no shieele keelaa ghane ɛ̂ bonyii bo Lum e
Me ŋgomte keen'yaw enya keyoone ɛ̂ Nyo' wɛm nje ben bocii nfele yî Jisos Klistu le, njefo woŋ tfuu jemyi ɛkumɛ fitele fì ben nu ɛ lese yî ye le.
Nyo' wvù me nlemte wvú le bô fitele fiem ficii yî saaka wvù jee wvu ɛkumɛ Waa we le leeme fwe wɛm lɛ me ŋké no ŋkumyi ben sekecii ɛ̂ bunle yɛm e.
Me ŋké ndioo mbunlee no nlɛke lɛ ɛ́ je nɛlo ɛ yenɛ, ɛ́ me ento ɛ̂ ben e keseen fɛn ɛ́ Nyo' ɛ bee,
njefo me ŋkooŋke naa baay keen'yɛn ben e wvu lɛ me eŋgaw nnya yì Keyoy ke Yuule nu ɛ nya ɛ̂ me beene, ɛ́ yí ege ɛ́ ben etɛmyi.
Fì nu lɛ, ɛ́ beene eyvuwsɛ mvuntelem mvusɛɛbeene, ɛ́ fitele fì ben lese yî Nyo' le eyvuwsɛ fiem, ɛ́ fiem eyvuwsɛ finɛn.

Boom bo bwɛɛm e, me ŋgomte lɛ ben ekiɛɛ lɛ me nu ɛ ŋkaw wase bokaŋ e bokaŋ e lɛ me nu ento ɛ̂ ben e, ŋké ŋkaw ɛ fiɛɛ jewse kɛ me. Ɛ me ŋgomte lɛ me ento wvu lɛ me eŋkɛŋkɛ ŋgbwele jo ben lɛŋlɛŋ no me nu ɛ ŋkɛŋkɛ wase jo bonyii bomew bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu.
Lemme din fô bonyii bocii le nu ɛ̂ kendoŋ kem e, kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu bonyii bò nu woŋ wvù yuu wase le, kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu bò bɛɛ ɛntfun, kɛnɛɛ bonyii bò kɛŋke bvufee, kɛnɛɛ bò bɛɛ biyuŋ.
Ɛ̀ nɛɛ fiɛɛ fì fitele bɛɛnci naa me baay keenfewcɛ saaka wvù jee ɛ̂ ben tɛn bò nu Lum.
Mvuŋgay mvu saaka wvù jee wvù wvu Nyo' le

Ben ekeè lɛ kɛ me ŋ'wuumene fiɛɛ fi ɛkumɛ saaka wvù jee wvù wvu Nyo' kɛ. Me ŋkee lo lɛ ɛ̀ nu fô mvuŋgay mvu Nyo' le keeboyse wee tfuu wvù nu ɛ lese fitele yî ye le nu. Ɛ saaka wvun yaake gɛne ɛ ɛ̀ nu fô Bojuu le sɛ gɛne tɛn fô bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu le.
Fì nu lɛ saaka wvù jee wvun duŋci je yì Nyo' joo lɛ wee nu teytey ɛ̂ wvú ɛjise le. Ɛ fifin kɛw ɛ gɛn ɛ mɛse yî fitele fì mwɛtɛn lese yî ye le. Ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì bó nu ɛ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Wee wvu teytey nu ke ecee nje fitele fì wvú lese yî Nyo' le.”

content: Shém ffuuke Nyo' no bonyii buwyi mwɛɛm
Me njemyi nɛn njefo shém Nyo' ké no ffuuke fowe bô bonyii bò maa lo wvú buwyi mwɛɛm, ɛ gee dibole dì befe yike kecɛɛy ke diɛw Nyo' le.
Yí ffuuke nonɛn njefo fiɛɛ fì bonyii nulo ekiɛɛ ɛkumɛ Nyo' yen'yi ɛndan, njefo wvú wvù Nyo' nu ɛ duŋcɛ wase ɛ̂ bó.

Ɛ kɛw naa lo foŋkɛw no Nyo' to bomɛɛ woŋ nu ɛ mvuŋgay mwew mvù mɛy lo, bô no wvú wvù Nyo' nu, nu ɛ bonyii ɛ yɛn wase ɛ bvuu ɛ kiɛɛ yî mwɛɛm mvù wvú bom e, naa no bonyii yaa cim yɛne wvú le kɛ. Nonɛn kɛ je bvuu nu dvú yì bó ke enɛ ewowlene duu lɛ kɛ bó kee Nyo' kɛ.
Naa no bó cim kee Nyo' nonɛn, kɛ bó wvumte wvú diɛwɛ Nyo' le kɛnɛɛ nyaa keyoone ɛ̂ wvú kɛ. Boŋkpwawcɛ bobole nu ɛ nɛ ɛ tu bo ɛcici. Bikuu bibole bi biyɛ nu ɛ yiŋsɛn kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu bô ɛjiwɛ.
Bó duu lɛ bó kɛŋke bvufee, ɛ kaa ɛ nɛ ɛ tu biyuŋ.

Bó nu ɛ shɛɛ keebunlee Nyo' bvukukɛ wvù yaa nulo ekpwe kɛ, ɛ fey ɛ no bunlee ɛ ɛ̀ nu mvumooso mvù bó kene bô can mvú ɛ no fieesene bonyii bò nulo ekpwekɛn, bô mvunyiim noo nyám yì lɛne we, bô yì sone kuse.
No fí nu nonɛn Nyo' ɛ mum ɛ cinɛ bó le bó ɛ no gee wase ɛ ɛ̀ nu mwɛɛm mvù mvuntelem mvubole shieele mvù ɛ̀ nu mwɛɛm mvu nnyɛn e, ɛ bó gee nonɛn bô ye yibo wee bô wee, mum shoose bikuu bibole.

Bó nu ɛ kumɛn kecɛɛy ke ɛkumɛ Nyo' ɛ tu mbiay, ɛ no bunlee bvuu lemte ɛ ɛ̀ nu mwɛɛm mvù Nyo' bom e ɛfey keebunlee bvuu lemte ɛ ɛ̀ nu wvú wvù Bomɛɛn e. Ɛ ɛ̀ nu wvú wvù bó kɛŋke keebensee sekecii sɛ ŋka. Fí enù nonɛn.
No bó gee nonɛn, Nyo' ɛ mum ɛ cinɛ bó le, ye ɛ no yvuwse bó keegee mwɛɛm mvu kenshoose le. Ɛ bokɛnɛ jiime fô bokɛnɛ le, ɛ Nyo' to baa bom wee lɛ wvú egeè nonɛn kɛ.

Ɛ ɛ̀ nu kɛ lɛŋlɛŋ no bolemsɛ cin'yi je yì Nyo' to geɛ keejiime bô bokɛnɛ le, ɛ ye yvuwse bó keejiime ɛ ɛ̀ nu fô bolemsɛ bomew e. Ɛ bolemsɛ gee mwɛɛm mvu kenshoose le bô bolemsɛ bomew. No bó gee nonɛn mum joo ŋgɛw yî bikuu bibole wvù ɛ̀ nu nlawma gee dibole dì befe.
No bonyii bodvu baa eyɛne lɛ fí nu lɛŋ keekiɛɛ Nyo', Nyo' ɛ mum ɛ cinɛ bó le lɛ bó ekɛŋke bvufee ɛ ɛ̀ nu bvu keyuŋ e, mum gee mwɛɛm mvù bó yaa kɛŋke keegee kɛ.

Mvuntelem mvubole ɛ mum ɛ no nu ɛ mvú ɛ yiŋsɛn bô mwɛɛm mvù befe jɛɛy jɛɛy. Bó buwyi mwɛɛm, dewkene ɛjisɛ, kɛŋke mvuntelem mvù befe, bene bindoŋ bô bonyii, yuwyi bonyii, diuu bvudiuw, lɛɛle kenlɛɛma, ŋgomgome bô mwɛɛm, kunsene mvuŋkunsɛn,
beete bô ɛdiee ɛ bonyii, bane Nyo', sɛɛnene kensɛɛnɛn, tɛmyi bikuu, saale ye, momte kuw, tɛmyi bikuu bô bo'icee bobole noo bobwee bobole.
Bó nu biyuŋ yaa leeme yî diɛw yibole kɛ. Bó nyɛwle bô bonyii bomew, yaa camte shen fô bonyii le kɛ.
Bó gee nonɛn kee kɛ naa lɛ Nyo' nu ɛ leke wase lɛ wee wvù gee mvumvun mwɛɛm nu ɛ wvú kɛŋke keekpwe. Geenɛn, bó ɛ no gee kɛ gɛne dvú, bvuu bɛnsee bonyii bò gee kfuu mvumwɛ mwɛɛm.

footnotes.text: Kɛnɛɛ lɛ, “Jisos Klistu nu ɛ Nyo' to duŋcɛ bô mvuŋgay fele yî Keyoy ke Yuule le lɛ ɛ̀ nu Waa wen no wvú to bvusɛɛ wvú yî kpwe le”.
